يحتضر (form VIII)
# يَحْتَضِرُ (yaḥtaḍiru) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# يُحْتَضَرُ (yuḥtaḍaru) /juħ.ta.dˤa.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# يَحْتَضِرَ (yaḥtaḍira) /jaħ.ta.dˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive o
